Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can activate this effect."return 1 card from your hand on top of your deck" is not a "by , " effect ("by returning..."), so you gain 1 memory even when you can't perform that action.However, if you do have cards in your hand, you must return 1 card on top of the deck.
Card Q&A.q: Can I activate this card's [Your Turn] effect and gain 1 memory even when I have 0 cards in my hand?

Effect: [On Play] Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. Add 1 Digimon card with the [Evil], [Wizard], or [Demon Lord] trait among them to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
[Your Turn] When one of your Digimon digivolves into a purple Digimon, by suspending this Tamer, return 1 card from your hand on top of your deck and gain 1 memory.
Security Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
